# S5.5 — C3 orchestration depth: T3 recursion, priors, voi_weighted, explain, belief_divergence (§5e.2–§5e.5, §5f.3)

**Stacked on:** `svitali/harnessharness-s5.4` (PR #86) · **Do not merge — operator-controlled**

## Summary

Lands the C3 orchestration depth that needed
Stage-4 data — under the `offline-only` budget
(`R-2.6.3`, `R-2.6.4` Stage-5, `R-2.6.5`
Stage-5, `R-2.6.2¹`, `R-2.7.2b` Stage-5).

The two interrupted-worker WIP commits are
preserved and verified: `4f2e560` lands
`three_way_text{ast(grammar)}` (tagged-CST
tokenizer + diff3 + typed conflict records —
never a silent pick) and the share-mode
groundwork; `dfec1ff` lands the scheduler's
`code`-owned delegate binding, profile-conditioned
delegation rules with `PolicyDebt`,
`bandit`/`surface_prior` policies over
`PriorCell`s with `prior_reset`,
`voi_weighted` allocation, the `belief_probe`
profile-rule kind + `belief_divergence` fold,
trace-view `explains[]`, and the T3
orchestration tests.

This run audited that residue and closed the
remaining legs:

- **`hh-ledger::classes`** —
  `measurement.experiment.inclusion_probabilities`
  and `verification.belief.probe` registered
  (durable + provenance-mandatory; the former was
  emitted but unregistered — a SchemaViolation at
  append).
- **`lab/value-of-compute-v1`** — the `bandit`
  policy level joins the `matched_cap` covering
  product ({static, uniform, rules, bandit} × 2
  models × 2 suites × 2 budgets); the funded
  warm-up arms bind `matched_total` ({rules,
  bandit} × models × suites at tight — M3 equal
  totals); a searched arm under `matched_cap`
  stays `IncommensurableMatch` (AC-R-2.6.4-12).
- **`lab/coordination-topology-v1`** — the
  environment factor ({coding, terminal}) plus a
  second `matched_cap{time.wall_ms}` comparand
  group over the same points; `delegation_v1`
  aligned to the Stage-5 topology set.
- **`hh-experiment`** — engine tests for
  `voi_weighted`: the inclusion table lands
  before the pick (`charged_to: instrument`),
  the draw is replay-deterministic, and the
  strategy refuses outside `adaptive_search`
  (`AdaptiveOutsideSearch`; held-out-touching
  specs refuse too) — AC-R-2.6.4-13.
- **`hh-telemetry`** — acceptance tests for
  `explains[]` (per-`control.compute.decided`
  rows; `fallback` renders from the
  `*.cold_start` marker) and for
  `belief_divergence` (`provisional` on every
  report — including the `n/a{observability}`
  cell without `model_io`; judged/deterministic
  strata never merge) — AC-R-2.7.2b-6.
